PAI: Backed by 40 years of part manufacturing experience, PAI Industries has been providing the heavy-duty truck industry with high-quality service parts for the engine, gearing, exhaust, suspension, and electrical systems. This brand has been manufacturing its products in the USA since 1973, and it owes its worldwide success to its dedicated and experienced employees. PAI takes pride in being an ISO 9001:2015-certified auto and truck parts manufacturer.
MACK: Mack Trucks has been building heavy-duty trucks and engines since 1900. As part of the Volvo Group, Mack is known worldwide for durable Class 8 trucks and genuine replacement parts engineered for the toughest over-the-road and vocational applications.
CUMMINS: Cummins Inc. designs and manufactures diesel and natural gas engines, power generation systems, and related components. Founded in 1919, Cummins powers millions of heavy-duty trucks and industrial applications around the world.
CATERPILLAR: Caterpillar Inc. is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, and industrial gas turbines. Cat genuine parts are engineered to exact specifications for maximum durability and performance.
CATERPILLAR-REPLACEMENT: Caterpillar Inc. is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, and industrial gas turbines. Replacement parts are engineered to Cat specifications for maximum durability and performance.
VOLVO: Volvo Trucks is a global manufacturer of heavy-duty commercial vehicles, part of the Volvo Group. Volvo genuine parts are engineered for reliability, safety, and efficiency across long-haul and vocational applications.
UNITED PACIFIC: United Pacific is a leading manufacturer of aftermarket parts and accessories for heavy-duty trucks, specializing in chrome and stainless steel accessories, lighting, and interior components.
MILWAUKEE: Milwaukee Tool is a leading manufacturer of heavy-duty power tools, hand tools, and accessories for professionals, known for its M12 and M18 cordless systems and cordless innovation.
DANA: Dana Incorporated is a global leader in drivetrain and e-propulsion systems. Dana Spicer axles, driveshafts, and sealing solutions deliver performance for commercial vehicles and off-highway equipment.
BENDIX: Bendix Commercial Vehicle Systems is a leader in air brake charging and control systems, advanced safety technologies, and wheel-end solutions for medium and heavy-duty commercial vehicles.
WABCO: WABCO, now part of ZF, pioneered air brake systems for commercial vehicles. WABCO braking, stability, and suspension control technologies are trusted on trucks, buses, and trailers worldwide.
EATON CORPORATION: Eaton Corporation is a diversified power management company. Eaton Fuller transmissions and clutches are the standard for heavy-duty commercial vehicles.
GATES CORPORATION: Gates Corporation is a leading manufacturer of power transmission belts and fluid power products. Gates heavy-duty belts, hoses, and tensioners deliver reliable performance under extreme conditions.
BALDWIN: Baldwin Filters has manufactured heavy-duty filtration products since 1936, delivering lube, air, fuel, hydraulic, and coolant filters engineered for engine protection.
ACDELCO: ACDelco is General Motors' premium aftermarket parts brand, offering a full line of automotive and heavy-duty replacement parts known for quality and durability.
3M: 3M applies science and innovation to create products that solve real-world problems. In the heavy-duty industry, 3M provides adhesives, tapes, abrasives, and protective products.
SKF: SKF is a world leader in bearings, seals, and lubrication systems. SKF wheel bearings and seals deliver long service life for trucks and trailers.
THERMO KING: Thermo King, a Trane Technologies brand, is a global leader in transport temperature control. Thermo King refrigeration units keep cargo at precise temperatures.
DORMAN: Dorman Products provides aftermarket replacement parts and repair solutions, known for OEM-fix innovation across automotive and heavy-duty applications.
STANDARD IGNITION: Standard Motor Products is a leading manufacturer of ignition, emission control, and electrical components for the automotive aftermarket.
BORG WARNER: BorgWarner is a global leader in clean, efficient propulsion technologies, including turbochargers, transmission, and engine timing systems.
FEDERAL MOGUL: Federal-Mogul, now part of Tenneco, is a global supplier of engine, sealing, and braking components trusted across the commercial vehicle industry.
FEDERAL MOGUL-ABEX: Federal-Mogul, now part of Tenneco, is a global supplier of engine, sealing, and braking components. The Abex line is a trusted name in heavy-duty friction and brake parts.
PHILLIPS INDUSTRIES: Phillips Industries is a leading supplier of electrical and air brake interface components for the commercial vehicle industry.
PETERSON LIGHTING: Peterson Manufacturing is a leader in commercial vehicle safety lighting, providing LED lamps, reflectors, and harness systems.
HORTON: Horton is a global leader in engine cooling fan drives and replacement components for heavy-duty trucks and off-highway equipment.
FREIGHTLINER: Freightliner Trucks, a Daimler Truck brand, is a leading North American manufacturer of Class 5-8 commercial vehicles.
SAF HOLLAND: SAF-HOLLAND is a leading supplier of fifth wheels, landing gear, and suspension systems for trucks and trailers.
JOST: JOST is a global manufacturer of fifth wheel couplings, kingpins, and landing gears for commercial vehicles.
DENSO POWEREDGE: DENSO is a leading global supplier of advanced automotive technology, including heavy-duty starters, alternators, and engine management components.
DAYTON PARTS: Dayton Parts is a leading North American supplier of heavy-duty truck and trailer suspension components, leaf springs, and steer axle components.
MAGNAFLOW EXHAUST PRODUCT: MagnaFlow designs premium performance exhaust systems and catalytic converters for automotive and heavy-duty applications.
GEARWRENCH: GEARWRENCH is a professional hand tool brand known for innovation, including ratcheting wrenches and specialty tools.
WORLD AMERICAN: World American is a supplier of heavy-duty truck and trailer parts, offering a broad line of drivetrain and suspension components.
ROADWARRIOR: RoadWarrior is a brand of heavy-duty truck aftermarket parts, including diesel particulate filters and exhaust aftertreatment components.
CENTRIC: Centric Parts is a leading manufacturer of brake system components, offering rotors, drums, calipers, and pads for automotive and heavy-duty applications.
DINEX: Dinex is a global manufacturer of exhaust and emission systems for heavy-duty vehicles, including diesel particulate filters and catalysts.
NEAPCO: NEAPCO designs and manufactures driveline and drivetrain products, including driveshafts, couplings, and steering components for commercial vehicles.
NEWSTAR: NewStar is a supplier of aftermarket heavy-duty truck and trailer parts, providing a broad range of replacement components.
TRAMEC SLOAN: Tramec Sloan is a supplier of air brake components, brass fittings, and coiled assemblies for the commercial vehicle industry.
PERFORMANCE FRICTION: Performance Friction is a global manufacturer of high-performance brake pads and rotors, trusted in motorsports and heavy-duty applications.
GLOBAL INDUSTRIAL: Global Industrial is a leading distributor of industrial and maintenance supplies, equipment, and MRO products.
PIONEER: Pioneer is a supplier of automotive and heavy-duty remanufactured components, including starters and alternators.
